newsitem.title: USA: Dravo Corp names Arthur Byrnes chairman.
newsitem.headline: Dravo Corp names Arthur Byrnes chairman.

text.p: Dravo Corp said Monday that Arthur Byrnes, chairman of Deltec Asset Management and a Dravo director since 1993, had been named chairman of the board.
In his new position, the company said, Byrnes will serve in a non-executive capacity.
As president and chief executive officer, the company said, Carl Gilbert will continue to serve as Dravo's top executive.
Additionally, the company said, Peter Kross, senior vice president, investments, with Everen Securities, was elected to Dravo's board, effective as of the next board meeting.
The company said Kross brings to seven the number of directors on Dravo's board.
